litigation.mdlName: In re: Bard Implanted Port Catheter Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, District of Arizona

phase: Court-directed settlement process and remand planning
phaseDetail: CMO 52 says the November 13 conference addressed a proposed settlement process and the remand or transfer of cases that do not settle. New cases may be transferred to or directly filed in MDL-3081 through February 28, 2027. The parties then have until September 1, 2027 to attempt to negotiate settlement of cases pending in the MDL. Cases with a release or term sheet executed by that date may remain until March 1, 2028 to complete paperwork and file a stipulated dismissal; other cases are to be recommended for remand or transferred under 28 U.S.C. § 1404(a). The order does not publish a settlement fund, eligibility grid, individual payout amount, or guaranteed resolution.

settlements.label: Court-directed settlement and remand process
settlements.status: process ordered; public agreement terms not identified
settlements.detail: CMO 52 establishes deadlines for a proposed settlement process and for remand or transfer of cases that do not settle. It does not announce a global settlement agreement, settlement amount, claimant eligibility grid, or individual payment schedule.
settlements.individualClaims: Whether a particular claim resolves depends on the parties' negotiations and any applicable agreement. The order provides no fixed or guaranteed individual amount.

keyDates.label: MDL-3081 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized the cases before Judge David G. Campbell in Arizona.

keyDates.label: CMO 46 entered
keyDates.detail: The order addressed trial preparation and retained Miller in the bellwether pool; it is not a trial result.

keyDates.label: Divelbliss verdict filed
keyDates.detail: $40 million compensatory award. No punitive damages.

keyDates.label: CMO 52 entered
keyDates.detail: The court set a settlement/remand process after the November 13 conference. The order does not publish settlement amounts or eligibility terms.

keyDates.label: Joint settlement-status memorandum due
keyDates.detail: CMO 52 directs the parties to propose processes for settlement-status updates, videotaped trial testimony, and preparation of remand or transfer records.

keyDates.label: New MDL transfer and direct-filing cutoff
keyDates.detail: CMO 52 sets February 28, 2027 as the closing date for new cases to be transferred to or directly filed in MDL-3081. It does not decide any state-law filing deadline.
keyDates.appliesTo: New cases seeking transfer to or direct filing in MDL-3081

keyDates.label: Settlement-negotiation cutoff for pending MDL cases
keyDates.detail: CMO 52 gives the parties through September 1, 2027 to attempt settlement of cases pending in the MDL. Cases without an executed release or term sheet by that date are to be recommended for remand or transferred under 28 U.S.C. § 1404(a).

keyDates.label: Settlement-paperwork and dismissal cutoff
keyDates.detail: Cases with a release or term sheet executed by September 1, 2027 may remain pending until March 1, 2028 to complete settlement paperwork and file a stipulated dismissal. Cases not dismissed by then are to be recommended for remand or transferred.
keyDates.appliesTo: MDL-3081 cases with an executed release or term sheet
